description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminCourseQueue web page in the Online Examination System. It contains event handlers for button clicks and grid view selection, managing page navigation and session state.

classes.name: AdminCourseQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminCourseQueue.aspx page, handling user interactions and navigation within the admin course queue interface.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the home button is clicked; navigates to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the profile button click event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the leaderboard button click event; navigates to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the logout button click event; navigates to the LoginPage.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection change in GridView2; stores selected row's ID in session and navigates to AdminCourseQueue.
